label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
output:
**PRIVATE – Gran’s no’ to see this!**

Hiya Mum, Kirsty and Linda,

Right, I’m buzzing about this. As a wee extra for Gran’s 80th, I’m doing everyone’s hair for free before we go out for her dinner.

Morag’s letting me have **Hair by Morag on Dumbarton Road** to myself on **Saturday 12 December from 1pm**. She closes at 12 on a Saturday, so we’ll have the whole place to ourselves for the afternoon. Gran’s birthday is the **Sunday 13th**, but the dinner’s booked for the Saturday night at **8.30pm** in the Italian place on Byres Road. The table’s for nine: us seven, plus Uncle Davie and Kirsty’s man.

That’s seven heads altogether — me, Mum, Kirsty, Linda, Gran, Ava and Ruby. Cuts and blowdries for everyone are absolutely fine, and I can do colours too, **but only if you let me know what you want by Friday 27 November**. I need to get everything ordered from the wholesaler, so please don’t leave it till the week before and then announce you fancy going pink, Kirsty.

I’ve also been thinking about Gran saying at Easter that she’d “love to go silver properly” but won’t pay salon prices. This could be my chance to sort that for her as part of the surprise. Ava and Ruby can get wee braids and glitter spray — they’ll love it, and it’ll make them feel properly included.

**Mum, you’re probably the best bet for getting Gran to the salon for 1pm without telling her why.** I’ll leave the cover story with you, but please make sure she’s actually there and not off doing something else!

Linda, we’ll be doing your colour at the salon this time, so your cooker and the dog are both safe.

Somebody bring a bottle of fizz and we’ll make an afternoon of it. Morag says that’s fine as long as we tidy up after ourselves.

So, give me a shout with what you want done — cuts, blowdries and any colours — **by Friday 27 November**. And remember, no’ a word to Gran!

Can’t wait. Love yous x
